samples.reason: This is a generative, open-format composition task asking the model to independently design a full structured outline with creative latitude ("all your call, surprise me"). It rewards strong generativity, novelty, and output breadth — precisely the profile where Petrel-235B's strong positive preference slope for generative tasks and its substantially higher benchmark scores (MMLU-Pro 79.6 vs 74.1, Arena-Hard 88.4 vs 80.9) make it the clearly superior choice. This is a generative, open-format composition task with explicit latitude ("all your call, surprise me with how you'd shape it") and asks for a detailed, structured creative-intellectual output. Petrel-235B's strongest preference slope is for generative tasks with novelty and output latitude, and it scores highest on Creative Generation in internal evals. While this also touches on structured academic work (where both models are competent), the user's invitation for autonomous design choices makes Petrel the better fit.

Plover's flat generativity preference slope and lower benchmark scores make it the weaker fit here.
